21912.overview: Get all the bumps, jumps, thrills, and spills of off-road rally racing in your hands with V-RALLY EDITION '99 for the Game Boy Color. Choose between four real-world rally cars: Peugeot 306 Maxi, the Mitsubishi Lancer WRC, V-Rally Ford Escort WRC, and Subaru Impreza WRC. Then race on 40 courses in exotic locations like Indonesia, Safari, Corsica, New Zealand, Alps, United Kingdom, Greece, Argentina, Italy, and Sweden. The terrain of each track has an effect on your car's performance, and you must be careful because snow, dirt, and asphalt all react differently. In addition to the terrain, keep an eye out for obstacles like rocks, oil slicks, hills, and jumps. You can get all of the off-road action you could ever want with V-RALLY EDITION '99

22116.overview: Try to break the bank and come away a millionaire in VEGAS GAMES. You can play 20 different casino games, both cards and machines. The card games include Blackjack and Baccarat. Bet on dice in Craps, or on the result of a spinning wheel in Money Wheel or Roulette. If lottery games are more your style, try to win big in Keno and Video Keno. There are five different versions of Video Poker to try including Deuces Wild, Tens or Better, Jokers Wild Double Down, Jacks or Better High Roller, and Jacks or Better Double Down. No casino is complete without slot machines, and VEGAS GAMES is no exception. This one has eight different machines to try: Ancient Treasures, Love 2 Win, Go Fish, Easy Money, Dynamite Dollars, Buffet, Buck Teeth, and Beyond the Stars. If you love to gamble, you will enjoy playing VEGAS GAMES.

25465.overview: It's 1975. A raid on a secret military base arms two psycho motor-gangs with enough firepower to wipe out the entire Southwest. And only you are crazy enough to join the fully-loaded, off-road warfare.

33108.overview: Step into the glamorous shoes of TV's baddest and blondest detective in V.I.P. for the Game Boy Color. You are Vallery Irons, a beautiful Los Angeles private eye (played by Pamela Anderson in the hit syndicated show). It's your dangerous duty to track down a famous movie star who has mysteriously vanished into thin air. But you aren't alone you're aided in your action-packed adventure by your V.I.P. team members: intelligence agent Tasha Dexter, martial arts specialist Johnny Loh, explosives expert Nikki Franco, weapons expert Quick Williams, and computer expert Kay Simmons. In V.I.P. you'll do it all drive sleek sportscars and take to the sea in a powerful speedboat, strap on rollerblades, and even blaze through the skies in a helicopter. All of the tongue-in-cheek humor and bullet-blasting, car-crashing mayhem of Pamela's television antics are here to be devoured in hours of Game Boy Color exploits.

145608.overview: The Visitors is a platform game on Gameboy. Play as Godefroy de Montmirail accompanied by Jacquouille in environments such as the forest or the castle. Jump over the void for your survival and kill enemies by throwing knives or swords at them.
